cases.name: gate: a bun that says 1.4.0 to --version
setup:
printf '#!/bin/sh
case "$1" in --version) echo 1.4.0; exit 0 ;; esac
exec "%s" "$@"
' "$(command -v bun)" > <ROOT>/fakebin/bun

skip.win32: a shell script named bun is not bun.exe
